paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation:
This plot illustrates the relative change in performance when applying layer-wise quantized pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct across different layer groups, comparing various configurations of token counts and bit precisions. The x-axis is categorical, displaying five layer group labels: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32. The y-axis represents "Relative Change" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately -25% to 5%, with tick marks at -25%, -15%, -5%, and 5%.

A gray dashed horizontal line represents the baseline of 4×tokens at 4-bit precision, held constant at 0% across all layer groups. The yellow line with circle markers, representing LB-Avg of 2×tokens at 8-bit, starts near 0% at Layer1-4, remains close to 0% at Layer5-12, dips slightly to approximately -1% at Layer13-20, returns to near 0% at Layer21-28, and stays near 0% at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers, representing LB-Avg of 1×tokens at 16-bit, starts at approximately 0% at Layer1-4, drops to around -1% at Layer5-12, decreases further to approximately -5% at Layer13-20, recovers to about -1% at Layer21-28, and returns to approximately -1% at Layer29-32. The light blue line with circle markers, representing RULER4k of 2×tokens at 8-bit, begins at approximately -2% at Layer1-4, decreases to about -3% at Layer5-12, drops sharply to approximately -13% at Layer13-20, recovers to about -2% at Layer21-28, and ends at approximately -1% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers, representing RULER4k of 1×tokens at 16-bit, starts at approximately -3% at Layer1-4, decreases to about -5% at Layer5-12, drops steeply to approximately -26% at Layer13-20, recovers to about -5% at Layer21-28, and ends at approximately -3% at Layer29-32. All non-baseline lines exhibit their most pronounced negative values at the Layer13-20 group, with varying degrees of recovery at subsequent layer groups.
